newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor futures market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Bombay Oilseeds and Oils Exchange, which conducts castorseed futures trade, was closed on Thursday for a national holiday. It will reopen on Friday.
On Wednesday castorseed June delivery was steady at 1,115 rupees per quintal after opening 3.50 rupees higher on stray buying.
In edible oils, groundnut oil fell three rupees to 366 rupees per 10 kgs. It was steady at 368/369 rupees per 10 kg on Tuesday.
In Rajkot, groundnut oil was lower by two rupees at 568 rupees per 15 kg.
Palm oil lost two rupees to 293 rupees per 10 kg on reports of the arrival of a consignment of 3,000 tonnes from Malaysia.
